data: Microsoft reported diluted EPS of $11.80 in fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024), compared with $9.68 in fiscal 2023, an increase of $2.12 or about 21.9%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $88,136 million (roughly $88.1 billion), up from $72,361 million in fiscal 2023, which is about a 21.8% increase. Diluted weighted average shares were nearly flat at 7,469 million in fiscal 2024 versus 7,472 million in fiscal 2023, so the EPS growth was driven almost entirely by higher earnings rather than share count reduction.
